log.note: Digest identifies the decoded log inspected during research; it is not a digest of a compressed API response or a claim that the log is bundled.

source_audit.verification: Each downloaded source file matched its Git blob SHA1 and byte length. The literal table also matched the recorded SHA256.

theorem_boundaries.proved_external_statement: Blank-tape halting of the literal 253-state machine is equivalent to existence of a finite classical natural-deduction refutation of the explicit SIR, ZFc or ZFc+AC presentation.
theorem_boundaries.zfc_presentation: Std_iface.ZFc has equality axioms, Extensionality, Empty Set, Pairing, Union, Power Set, Infinity and universally closed Separation/Replacement instances; it omits Regularity and Choice. The theorem named ZFC adds the choice-set axiom.

ordinary_zfc_comparison.statement: ((ZFc + Regularity) + Choice) has a finite classical refutation iff ZFc has one.
ordinary_zfc_comparison.use: Compose with zf253_halts_iff_ZF to obtain the external full-ZFC refutation equivalence. This report did not compile an additional endpoint wrapper.
